justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/concurrent/ConstantInitializer.java, src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/concurrent/ConcurrentUtils.java, src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/concurrent/package-info.java, src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/concurrent/ConstantInitializerTest.java, and src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/concurrent/ConcurrentUtilsTest.java. The class itself is a small one-field wrapper: it implements only ConcurrentInitializer<T>, depends on java.util.Objects and the project exception type in a single get() signature, and has no internal collaborators or outgoing calls to other project classes. Fan-in is also low: the only concrete source use found outside its own test is one call in ConcurrentUtilsTest.java via new ConstantInitializer<>(value); ConcurrentUtils.java depends on the ConcurrentInitializer interface, not this class specifically. This is not high incoming/outgoing dependency behavior, so the hub-like modularization smell is not present.
